name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D drawSurface uz neukoncuje native batch pred kazdym surface. GDI fallbacky batch flushuji az pred skutecnym GDI kreslenim a smoke hlida, ze mala Direct2D scena zustava pod 5 batch beginy.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D drawSurface no longer ends the native batch before every surface. GDI fallbacks flush only before real GDI drawing and the smoke test guards that the small Direct2D scene stays below 5 batch begins.

history.changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D drawSurface uz neukoncuje native batch pred kazdym surface. GDI fallbacky batch flushuji az pred skutecnym GDI kreslenim a smoke hlida, ze mala Direct2D scena zustava pod 5 batch beginy.
history.changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: Direct2D drawSurface no longer ends the native batch before every surface. GDI fallbacks flush only before real GDI drawing and the smoke test guards that the small Direct2D scene stays below 5 batch begins.
